content:
Unassign the administrator with admin_id  from the administrative unit with
admin_unit_id . The administrator user will still have restricted_by_admin_units
set to true , and if the admin is not assigned to any other admin unit they will not be
able to view any users or integrations. Be sure to change the value of
restricted_by_admin_units  to false  to permit that admin to view all users and
integrations. Requires "Grant administrators - Write" API permission.
